summary: The 8-K reports the posting of a presentation regarding FDA approval of LISRAYA (brepocitinib) for dermatomyositis and discloses the wholesale acquisition cost. No special situation event—M&A, tender, activist, or restructuring—is involved. The filing is routine disclosure of a product approval and pricing update, not a corporate control or capital structure event. Investors should monitor commercial uptake and reimbursement, but no transactional or risk-arbitrage angle applies.
